    One recorded trajectory. PGD is injected at frame 40 and stays on for the rest of the run.
    Coloured trace: the perturbed run. Grey dashed trace: the same frames as the agent would have seen them unperturbed (the clean twin), so a move both traces make is the scene changing and not the perturbation.
    Mahalanobis-GMM uses the same K = 10 model as every other figure in the chapter.
    A case study, not a statistical evaluation: one trajectory per perturbation.
    No rise/plateau/shape descriptors: they are defined for a smooth sweep and would merge a noisy 100-frame trace into one segment. The phase blocks and the largest single-frame steps carry the shape instead.
    frames, perturbed run: 100
    frames, clean twin: 100
